description: Validate freight identifiers by their public check-digit algorithms: shipping container numbers (ISO 6346), air waybill numbers (IATA modulus-7) and IMO ship numbers. text finds and validates every identifier in a string; value + type validates one (value without type is refused); type "consignment" with consignment validates a consignment object. An AWB names its airline only when one record holds the prefix; otherwise airline_candidates[] lists every holder, never a guessed carrier. AWB: airline prefix + the airline from the AWB-prefix dataset when ONE record holds the prefix — when several do (e.g. 020: Lufthansa and Lufthansa Cargo), airline is null and airline_candidates[] lists every holder with airline_note saying why, never a guessed carrier. For container TYPE specs use container_lookup; for the AWB-prefix dataset airline_lookup. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets. Structural only — a valid check digit means well-formed, NOT that the container, shipment or vessel exists.

consignment.description: With type "consignment": the consignment object to validate.

text.description: Free text to scan for container / AWB / IMO identifiers. Provide this OR value + type.

type.description: Type of value: container (ISO 6346), awb, imo; or consignment with the consignment argument.

value.description: One identifier to validate; requires type.

name: validate
title: Freight Identifier Validator
